verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is a SaaS compliance platform that ships AI agents for screening and transaction monitoring, so a training-data opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documented policy, setting, or contractual control that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The AI-related items cover agent escalation, human override and auto-remediation, which are adjacent features and do not address training-data use.
